method: Independent offline proposed-action and response evaluation, followed by semantic criterion review against held-out rubric. Evidence excerpts below are verbatim. No keyword-based scoring.
limitations: Synthetic fixture tool double, not production tool or Cowork runtime verification.
Authorized 20-address case tests first proposed request and bounded continuation plan, not completion of a 20-step tool loop.
No without-skill baseline was run, so this establishes behavior on these fixtures, not measured improvement over baseline.
